'''Feral vampyres''' are monsters found in the [[Haunted Woods]] east of [[Canifis]] and near the [[Abandoned Mine]]. They are weaker than other [[Vampyre (race)|vampyres]] and are vulnerable to all weapon types; unlike most vampyres which are only vulnerable to [[Silver bar|silver]] and [[blisterwood]]. Feral vampyres become unaggressive to players who have been given [[Vanescula Drakan|Vanescula]]'s blood mark during [[The Branches of Darkmeyer]].

If the player is wearing a [[holy symbol]] whilst being attacked by a feral vampyre, occasionally the vampyre will be debuffed, reducing their Attack, Strength, Defence, and Magic by 25%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/650998169736753152|date=5 October 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98468|archivedate=13 May 2023|quote=It reduces the vampire's strength, attack, defence and magic by 25%.}} This is indicated by the chatbox message "The vampyre is weakened by your holy symbol of saradomin", which is hidden by the spam filter. They will occasionally bite players' necks, sometimes [[Strength Stat Reduced|reducing the player's Strength level]] by one and causing the feral vampyre to recover a small amount of life points.

There are some non-attackable [[Spider (Haunted Woods)|spider]]s in the Haunted Woods that would follow players around and spawn a feral vampyre that leaps down from above with a different examine text.

==Trivia==
* The different levels of vampyre each have different sounds when attacking, but they all have the same sound when attempting to bite you.
* Vampyres were graphically updated on [[17 August]] [[2011]].
* They appear to wear a damaged version of a [[Vampyre Juvinate]]'s outfit.
* Feral vampyres used to be called "vampires", but this was changed to "vampyres" on [[31 August]] [[2011]] in a hidden update. Their name was changed again on [[20 July]] [[2015]] to "feral vampyres" in order to differentiate them from other NPCs.
* In [[Postbag from the Hedge]] feral vampyres are described as savage beasts that were once [[vampyre juvenile]]s and [[Vampyre Juvinate|juvinates]], but who have become considerably less intelligent, and have much less control over their powers. They are driven by their hunger and a kind of primal rage, unlike most other vampyric beings.{{CitePostbag |issue=19 |letter=Letter 4 |author=Solomon Lamescus}}. [[Mod Ana]] later stated that this lore is still relevant.{{CiteForum|author=Mod Ana|url=http://services.runescape.com/m=forum/forums.ws?16,17,566,62696454,1185,309921220,highlight,|title=^+^ Myreque Future V3 ^+^|forum=Future Game Updates|postdate=3 October 2011|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/0WSCK|archivedate=10 October 2011}}.
